Twelve graphs, each tensor in / tensor out, with the tokenizer, the mel front end, the image tiling / resize / unshuffle and the read-out on the host: decide_<L> for L128 / 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 4096, the vision tower, the projector and audio_<T> for T501 / 1001 / 2001 / 3001.
